That commit does add an entry for "/redfish/v1/Systems/system/Processors/{ProcessorId}/EnvironmentMetrics/" which lists the properties supported.

This commit needs to update the list to include the additional properties that are now part of the response.

I have updated Redfish.md to include the following additional sensor properties within the Processor `EnvironmentMetrics` section.
1. `EnergyJoules`
2. `EnergykWh`
3. `PowerWatts`
4. `TemperatureCelsius`

I've also updated the commit message to reflect these changes. Thanks for catching that!
Done
What if there is more than one endpoint returned by the mapper? Should that be treated as an error?
Since a sensor should ideally be associated with exactly one chassis, I've updated the logic `endpoints.size() > 1` to check  if  multiple associations are found.
Done
What if more than one object is in the mapper response? Should that be treated as an error?
As we are expecting only one sensor of each type per processor, I've added a `subtree.size() > 1` check to log an error and return `internalError` if the response is ambiguous.
Done
Looks okay to me, just on new minor comment on function name.

nit: function name would make more sense to indicate expectation of single sensor, and to map to its caller

I.e.
afterGetProcessorSensorExcerpt
Done, Function has renamed to `afterGetProcessorSensorExcerpt()`.
